newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Loh & Loh lists at 11.50 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Loh & Loh lists at 11.50 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian civil engineering firm Loh & Loh Corp Bhd debuted on Friday on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Second Board at 11.50 ringgit, against a 2.80 ringgit offer price.
The company, which is also involved in building and construction works, offered 4.80 million new shares.
At 0135 GMT, the stock was trading at 12.30 ringgit.
For the year ended December 31, 1995, the company posted turnover of 63.21 million ringgit and pre-tax profit of 8.39 million. Its net profit that year totalled 5.67 million.
It has estimated its 1996 pre-tax profit will be 10.04 million ringgit, and its net profit will total 6.99 million.
